A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work and contain complete, readable main text, equations, eight figures, nine tables, and Appendices A–J. Text and rendered-page comparisons support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original experiments on FUN/GO gene-product datasets and BenthicNet-E, plus Enron/Diatom results, computational comparisons, and sensitivity analyses in the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains the original experimental results on FUN/GO, BenthicNet-E, Enron, and Diatom, including the appendix analyses.

M1.justification: The hierarchical loss, node-wise imbalance weighting, ensemble uncertainty measures, focal weighting, and appendix method variants are unchanged. The Figure 1 spacing correction does not alter the procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same FUN/GO datasets, BenthicNet-E, Enron, and Diatom under the same scenarios. Tables 5–6 already represented GO results; correcting their caption references from FUN to GO does not change coverage.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain the same unweighted and imbalance-only controls, LPROS, HROS-PD, and focal-weighting variants. No comparator is added or removed.

E3.justification: Evaluation metrics, prediction thresholds, ensemble sizes, training budgets, encoder interpolation, and limited-data protocols are unchanged, including the settings in Appendices A and J.

E4.justification: The scheduler/mixed-loss, LPROS combination, dropout, hyperparameter sensitivity, node-level, and data-ablation analyses in Appendices D–F and H–J are retained without changes to their questions or evidence.

E5.justification: Uncertainty reporting, one-standard-deviation plot bands, and the greater-than-two-sigma highlighting conventions are unchanged. No run-count, seed, or statistical estimation information is added or revised.

E6.justification: Numerical results, uncertainty values, significance highlighting, plotted findings, and qualitative outcomes are unchanged throughout. The corrected dataset labels resolve presentation inconsistencies without reassigning results to different experiments.

T1.justification: The hierarchical constraint, loss and uncertainty definitions, scheduler equations, and appendix mathematical expressions are unchanged. No formal assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution statements, and conclusion retain the same claims about improved rare-node detection, up-to-fivefold recall gains, and benefits on challenging hierarchical classification tasks.

C2.justification: Interpretations of precision–recall tradeoffs, epistemic uncertainty performance, and diminishing benefits with stronger encoders or more data remain unchanged, as do the appendix qualifications.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware specifications, computational measurements, and code-access information are unchanged. The updated arXiv version link does not change reproducibility resources.

R1.justification: The cited works, related-work discussion, and positioning relative to resampling, hierarchical classification, and uncertainty-estimation research are unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 separates 'explorationweighting' into 'exploration weighting' in Figure 1, corrects dataset-label wording, and updates the version/date stamp. The prose and section organization otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Tables 5–6 replace erroneous FUN references with GO in their captions. Table 9 changes 'Dataset (FUN)' to 'Dataset', slightly narrowing and repositioning the table. Figure 1 receives a caption spacing correction; no figures or tables are added or removed.

improvement.justification: Correcting the GO captions in Tables 5–6 and removing the erroneous FUN heading from the Enron/Diatom results in Table 9 reduces confusion about dataset identity. Together with the Figure 1 spacing fix, these provide a limited improvement in clarity and consistency; the scientific evidence and conclusions remain unchanged.
